quote: We cover 27 tasks from five datasets [...] covering factual question answering, reasoning and mathematics.

Persona prompting is used across a wide range of tasks, from closed-form tasks such as code generation, mathematical reasoning, and factual QA, to more open-ended settings like research ideation and creative writing.
outputs: Text responses (answers to questions/solutions to problems)
The generated outputs include answers to factual questions, mathematical problem solutions, and reasoning-based responses in both multiple-choice and open-ended formats.

quote: We evaluate model behavior using [...] metrics defined in §3: Expertise Advantage [...] Robustness [...] and Fidelity [...] We extract answers from model responses using regex patterns to compare with ground truth answers.

We evaluate model behavior using the three metrics defined in §3: Expertise Advantage (performance gap between expert and baseline), Robustness (performance gap between worst-case irrelevant persona and baseline), and Fidelity (correspondence between performance and expected attribute rankings)... We extract answers from model responses using regex patterns to compare with ground truth answers.
